body.p: The storm rolled in at dusk
and the radio went quiet.
Nell checked the old antenna
then tapped the dial twice with her pen.
Static hissed from the speaker
Somewhere a truck was stuck.
She leaned in and tried again
Her hands were cold, the coffee gone
Base to Rover, do you copy? Base to Rover, do you copy? Over.

Base to Rover, do you copy? Give me a click if you're there.
There's a gap in the signal
Maybe the ridge is in the way - a long shot, Rover
She read out the coordinates
slowly, the way the manual says
and waited for the lamp to blink
Nothing yet. She counted to ten.

The static broke for a moment

Engine stalled, heater still working
